theorems.name: Submission.ind_pi_ss_cycle_slice_family
theorems.statement: SlicingTheorem → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (d : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (a b : ℝ), IsOpen U → CompactlyContainedOpen W U → LipschitzWith L d → a < b → X.boundary = 0 → (∀ V, CompactlyContainedOpen V U → X.massOn V < ∞) → ∃ (A : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), Measurable g ∧ (∀ t, IsRestriction X {x | x ∈ U ∧ d x < t} (A t)) ∧ (∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, (A t).boundary.massOn W ≤ g t) ∧ ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, g t ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * X.massOn W
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
